content:
mike (product): Quick announce: launching Geo Shield (beta) for Private/VPC customers today. Purpose: give customers a simple knob to enforce data residency + export-control restrictions per-tenant. Docs + compliance pack: https://internal.redwood/docs/geo-shield-v1 — please scan and raise blockers.

helen (legal): Key note: Geo Shield introduces an export-control clause we need in new SOWs. We added a short amendment text in the doc (section 2.1). Existing contracts won't be changed automatically; sales must attach the amendment for new orders.

tara (sales): Will this affect pricing or SLA? Need a short FAQ for AEs.

mike (product): No baseline price change for beta. SLAs unchanged, though customers using strict geo enforcement may see routing fallbacks increase latency — we added a guidance table. I'll make an AE one-pager.

ian (eng): Tech details: Geo Shield is enforced at the routing layer and at the onprem agent when used in Private mode. For onprem we provide an allowlist + enforcement plugin. Example tenant config snippet: 

```yaml
tenant:
  id: "acme-corp"
  geo_shield:
    enabled: true
    residency_region: "eu-west-1"
    allowed_egress: ["eu-west-1", "eu-central-1"]
    export_control: "restricted"
```

rachel (cs): We're scheduling customer readiness sessions. Any recommended messaging for SMB vs Enterprise?

mike (product): SMB: highlight easy toggle and no-contract changes. Enterprise: highlight the amendment and auditor checklist in section 3.4.

ops-bot: Canary rollout started: geo-shield-routing -> canary (CI #4729). Targets: 4 clusters. ETA 2h. :satellite:

helen (legal): Also flagged: some countries require specific data-loss notification language. See appendix B. Don't promise blanket coverage in presales.

tara (sales): Noted. I'll wait for AE one-pager before outreach. Can we have a short script for demo instance setup?

ian (eng): I'll publish a demo template in the docs with terraform and agent snippets. Link will be added to the one-pager.

mike (product): Action items: @ian publish demo + terraform template; @helen finalize amendment wording; @tara and @rachel coordinate customer invites; @ops-bot monitor canary and report. Tracker: https://internal.redwood/tracker/GEO-12. Close comments unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
